exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-27T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix label-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

# Create accepts unsigned and positive terms, including comma-separated and
# repeated input, and stores only plain labels.
exec card create 'Signed labels' --label phase:old,+positive --label repeated
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/created.txt
exec card --json show label-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/created.json

# Removal terms are invalid during creation.
! exec card create 'Invalid removal' --label -plain
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/create-removal-error.txt

# A following long flag remains a missing label value.
! exec card create 'Missing label' --label --priority 1
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/missing-label-error.txt

# Edit maps signed terms to one atomic add/remove request.
exec card issue edit label-1 --label +phase:new --label -phase:old
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edited.txt
exec card --json show label-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/edited.json

# One label cannot be both added and removed.
! exec card issue edit label-1 --label conflict,-conflict
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/conflict-error.txt

# Apply label sets remain unsigned and reject reserved stored-label prefixes.
! exec card apply apply-reserved-label.json
stderr 'label cannot start with \+ or -'

-- apply-reserved-label.json --
{"version":1,"issues":[{"title":"Apply reserved","type":"task","labels":{"values":["+reserved"]}}]}
-- golden/created.txt --
label-1
-- golden/created.json --
{"id":"label-1","title":"Signed labels","type":"task","lifecycle":"open","status":"ready","priority":2,"active_claim":null,"created":1785153600,"updated":1785153600,"revision":2,"labels":["phase:old","positive","repeated"],"depends_on":[],"blocks":[],"log_count":0,"blocked":false,"parent_id":null,"attachments":[]}
-- golden/create-removal-error.txt --
error: create --label does not accept removal terms
-- golden/missing-label-error.txt --
error: --label: expected label value but got "--priority" (long flag)
-- golden/edited.txt --
edited label-1
-- golden/edited.json --
{"id":"label-1","title":"Signed labels","type":"task","lifecycle":"open","status":"ready","priority":2,"active_claim":null,"created":1785153600,"updated":1785153600,"revision":3,"labels":["phase:new","positive","repeated"],"depends_on":[],"blocks":[],"log_count":0,"blocked":false,"parent_id":null,"attachments":[]}
-- golden/conflict-error.txt --
error: invalid input: a label cannot be both added and removed
